resources.name: AI Horde Crowdsourced Inference
resources.description: Community-run, open-source crowdsourced inference service where volunteers share GPUs to serve text and image generation through an API; no paid tier, requests are prioritised by Kudos rather than money.
resources.pricing_notes: Landing page describes the service as free and community run, funded by sponsors rather than per-token charges; the API spec prices requests in Kudos, an internal priority currency, not currency. No paid plan is documented.
resources.included_limits: Anonymous API keys are accepted without registration and always share generations with LAION, which reduces Kudos consumption by 2; the API spec documents an upfront-Kudos requirement error (KudosUpfront) for some requests and an optional downgrade of resolution/steps for accounts without enough Kudos; async image requests expire after 10 minutes and text requests after 20 minutes. No numeric per-day request quota is stated.
resources.eligibility_requirements: No account required to submit requests; registration only needed to accumulate Kudos and to use non-anonymous features.
resources.country_availability: Not restricted by the documentation read; service is internet-accessible and volunteer-worker based.
resources.verification_evidence: Source: https://aihorde.net/. Accessed 2026-11-19 UTC. Observed: AI Horde describes itself as 'Free, community run, open source', where volunteers share their computers so anyone can generate images and text for free. Per-user kudos/priority limits are documented in the client and API docs rather than on the landing page; no payment method or paid tier is offered.
resources.notes: Researcher: AGENT. Accessed 2026-11-19 UTC. Observed: aihorde.net landing page states the service is free, community run and open source, with volunteers sharing hardware and sponsors covering costs; the downloaded official OpenAPI spec (v2.6) documents anonymous keyless use, Kudos-based priority, upfront-Kudos errors, 10/20-minute async request lifetimes, and an `nsfw` flag that skips workers which censor images. Provider-documented content policy: the spec exposes an explicit `nsfw` request flag plus a `censor_nsfw` option, i.e. NSFW generations are a supported request class routed only to workers that do not censor, while a moderator-filter and prompt-moderation endpoint set exists; the prose terms page itself did not render in the fetch. Remaining uncertainty: exact Kudos balances granted to new accounts, any per-IP request cap, and the full text of the hosted terms page.

resources.pricing_notes: The first activation in the Singapore region grants a free quota automatically. After the quota expires or is exhausted, eligible usage is billed pay-as-you-go at the model's input and output prices unless Free Quota Only mode is enabled to stop service at the limit.
resources.included_limits: Each eligible model typically receives 1,000,000 tokens, shared between input and output tokens. The quota is independent per model and cannot be transferred. Validity is 90 days from activation, model release, or model-request approval, whichever is later. Only real-time inference in the Singapore region with International deployment scope is covered; batch inference, fine-tuning, model deployment, custom models, PAI-DSW, and OSS storage and requests are excluded. OAuth authentication has a separate quota of 2,000 calls per day.
resources.eligibility_requirements: A new Alibaba Cloud account that completes account information and activates Model Studio in the Singapore region. The account and its RAM users share one quota. Re-registering a new account does not grant an additional new-user quota.
resources.country_availability: Singapore region only, with the service deployment scope set to International. Models in other regions or with other deployment scopes are not eligible.
resources.verification_evidence: Source: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/new-free-quota. Accessed 2026-10-22 UTC. Observed: first activation in Singapore grants a free quota; each eligible model typically has 1,000,000 tokens shared by input and output; validity is 90 days with no pause for inactivity; only real-time inference with International scope is covered; batch, fine-tuning, deployment, custom models, PAI-DSW, and OSS are excluded; account information must be completed; re-registering does not grant another quota. resources.name: ModelScope API Inference with Magicube Credits
resources.description: ModelScope API Inference paid for with free Magicube credits earned through daily login and community activity; no cash purchase needed for the free allowance.
resources.pricing_notes: API Inference is provided free of charge to registered ModelScope users and covers over 500 models, including Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM and Kimi. It is described as a non-commercial, non-profit product provided through Alibaba Cloud computing resources; commercial use is directed to commercial platforms. Magicubes are free compute credits: daily login grants 200 Magicubes/day (short-term, valid for the current day only); linking an Alibaba Cloud account adds 50/day; one-time profile actions (verify email, write a bio, customize profile page) grant 50 long-term Magicubes each. Magicubes are redeemable for Civision inference, Civision training and API Inference.
resources.included_limits: API base URL (OpenAI-compatible): https://api-inference.modelscope.cn/v1; Anthropic-compatible API: https://api-inference.modelscope.cn. API Inference costs about 0.5 Magicubes per call for lightweight models, about 1 per call for standard models and about 2 per call for flagship models — so a daily login alone covers roughly 200 standard-model calls per day. Per-model daily limit: 200 requests; 20 requests/second per model; maximum input 2,000 characters; maximum output 2,000 tokens; maximum 2,000 concurrent sessions; 1 image per request. Short-term Magicubes expire at 00:00 the day after distribution; long-term Magicubes expire 90 days after distribution.
resources.eligibility_requirements: ModelScope account with a verified email is required to use Magicubes. Before using API Inference, the user must bind an Alibaba Cloud account and complete real-name verification on that cloud account. Registration needs a username (6-20 characters), mobile number with SMS verification, and password. Not for high-concurrency online tasks or SLA-backed use.
resources.verification_evidence: Sources: https://www.modelscope.cn/docs/magicube/intro, https://www.modelscope.cn/docs/model-service/API-Inference/intro, https://www.modelscope.cn/docs/model-service/API-Inference/limits, https://www.modelscope.cn/docs/accounts/aliyun-binding-and-authorization. Observed: 'API-Inference is provided free of charge to registered ModelScope users' and 'provides free API inference for over 500 models' including Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM and Kimi; described as a non-commercial, non-profit product. OpenAI-compatible base URL https://api-inference.modelscope.cn/v1; Anthropic-compatible https://api-inference.modelscope.cn. Daily login grants 200 Magicubes/day (short-term); API Inference costs about 0.5/1/2 Magicubes per call for lightweight/standard/flagship models. Per-model limits: 200 requests/day, 20 requests/second, max input 2,000 characters, max output 2,000 tokens. Eligibility: must bind an Alibaba Cloud account and complete real-name verification before using API Inference. Docs discrepancy noted: the TTS example uses host api-inference.modelscope.ai instead of .cn. Remaining uncertainty: card requirement not stated on any page opened; no standalone pricing page found.

resources.name: Puter.js Free AI API

resources.pricing_notes: User-Pays model: each end user pays for the resources they consume through their own Puter account, so the developer's infrastructure cost stays at $0 — no API keys to manage, no billing to set up, no server infrastructure. Every user starts with a free monthly allowance; if a user runs out, Puter prompts them to upgrade. The tutorial page's 'no usage restrictions / no rate limits' wording is marketing and contradicts the finite allowance, so it is not recorded as fact.

The docs state more than 400 AI models are available, including OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Grok, GLM, DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral and Llama, plus image, video and speech generation. The dollar or token amount of the free monthly allowance is not stated on the pages read; no daily or per-request cap is stated.
resources.eligibility_requirements: End users need a free Puter account and must sign in; this is a frontend JS SDK, not a traditional API-key REST API.
resources.verification_evidence: Sources: https://developer.puter.com/tutorials/free-unlimited-ai-api/ (updated 2026-09-01) and https://docs.puter.com/user-pays-model/. Accessed 2026-11-07 UTC. Observed: User-Pays model — each end user pays for their own usage through their own Puter account, so the developer's infrastructure cost stays at $0, with no API keys, billing setup or server infrastructure. Every user starts with a free monthly allowance and is prompted to upgrade when it runs out. Access is via the JS SDK (CDN js.puter.com/v2 or npm @heyputer/puter.js) with puter.ai.chat and other calls; docs state more than 400 models, including OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Grok, GLM, DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral and Llama, plus image, video and speech. The tutorial's 'no usage restrictions / no rate limits' wording is not recorded as fact because the allowance is finite. Remaining uncertainty: the allowance amount in dollars or tokens, any daily or per-request cap, and whether a card is required for an account or upgrade.
resources.notes: Researcher: AGENT. Accessed 2026-11-07 UTC. Framing matters: free for the developer ($0, no key, no backend); end users get an unstated free monthly allowance, after which they pay. Do not record as 'free unlimited API'. Whether a card is required for a Puter account or for upgrading is not stated on the pages read.
